app.name: Half Lid
status.active.grace: Work just ended, waiting a little
status.stopped.overrideFailed: Could not keep the Mac awake
cli.usage:
Usage: halflid <status [--json] | start [30 | 2h] | stop | repair | version>
Developer commands: probe, signals, watch, icon, simulate, guard, cursor, screen-test, sleep-test, run
cli.sleepTest.start: Lid override is on. Close the lid now and keep it closed for 40 seconds, then open it. Waiting up to 60 seconds.
cli.sleepTest.closed: Lid closed. In 3 seconds the override is released and the Mac should go to sleep.
cli.sleepTest.timeout: The lid was not closed within 60 seconds. Everything was restored.
cli.sleepTest.done: Done. Unlock the Mac and paste the lines above.
cli.screenTest.noLid: This Mac has no lid sensor, so the screen test cannot run.
cli.screenTest.noGuard: The guard process could not be started. Test cancelled.
cli.screenTest.overrideFailed: The lid override could not be turned on: {reason}
cli.screenTest.start: Lid override is on. Close the lid now, wait about 15 seconds, then open it. Waiting up to 60 seconds.
cli.screenTest.closed: Lid closed: locking the screen and turning the display off.
cli.screenTest.timeout: The lid was not closed within 60 seconds. Everything was restored.
cli.screenTest.done: Restored. Unlock the Mac to continue.
cli.alreadyRunning: Another Half Lid (the app or another run) is already running.
cli.resourcesMissing: Resources not found. Set HALFLID_RESOURCES to the folder that contains i18n and agents.json.
panel.welcome: Close the lid while an agent is working and the Mac keeps going. When the work ends, everything goes back to normal.
notify.holdEnding.title: Keep awake ends soon
notify.holdEnding.body: In about 5 minutes the Mac is free to sleep again.
notify.workFinished.title: Work finished
notify.workFinished.body: The Mac can sleep again. Session: {duration}.
cli.notRunning: Half Lid is not running. Open it from the Applications folder.
cli.controlDisabled: Command-line control is turned off. Turn it on in Half Lid Settings, under General.
cli.noAnswer: Half Lid did not answer. Is it running?
cli.badDuration: Not a valid duration: {value}. Use minutes (30) or hours (2h), up to one week.
settings.title: Half Lid Settings
settings.needsMenuBarApp: Half Lid is not running. Open it again to change this.
settings.general.login.detail: So it is already running when you close the lid.
settings.general.login.approval: macOS is waiting for your approval.
settings.general.login.unavailable: Available once Half Lid is installed in the Applications folder.
settings.general.login.error: The login item could not be changed: {reason}
settings.general.commandLine.toggle: Let the halflid command control Half Lid
settings.general.commandLine.detail: Allows halflid start, halflid stop and halflid status in Terminal and in scripts.
settings.general.reset.title: Reset all settings?
settings.general.reset.message: Agents, lid behavior, safety limits, notifications and language go back to their defaults. The login item stays as it is.
settings.agents.intro: Half Lid keeps the Mac awake while these agents are working. Turn off the ones it should ignore.
settings.agents.privacy: Half Lid never reads what you write to your agents or what they answer. It only looks at whether they are running and active.
settings.agents.cursor: Reads the status of its chats, never their text.
settings.agents.cli: Recognized by its running process and recent file activity.
settings.agents.untested: Not tested on a real install yet.
settings.lid.intro: What happens when you close the lid while Half Lid is keeping the Mac awake.
settings.lid.lock.detail: Whoever opens the lid finds the lock screen.
settings.lid.displayOff.detail: Saves power and keeps the Mac cooler. The display comes back when you open the lid.
settings.lid.footer: When nothing is working, the Mac goes to sleep with the lid closed, as usual.
settings.safety.intro: Half Lid stops keeping the Mac awake when one of these limits is reached. Values outside the safe range are corrected automatically.
settings.safety.battery.detail: Applies on battery power only. Half Lid warns at the first level and stops at the second.
settings.safety.time.detail: The longest Half Lid keeps the Mac awake in one go. Opening the lid starts a new count.
settings.safety.heat.detail: macOS rates how hard the Mac is struggling with heat; Serious is the recommended level. A battery temperature counts once it stays above the value for a minute.
settings.safety.grace.detail: How long Half Lid waits after the last sign of work. A longer wait rides out slow networks.
settings.notifications.footer: Notifications never contain anything about your work: only what Half Lid is doing.
settings.notifications.status.denied: Turned off for Half Lid in System Settings.
settings.notifications.status.undetermin: macOS asks for permission when you turn this on.
settings.notifications.status.unavailabl: Available once Half Lid is installed in the Applications folder.
settings.notifications.onStop: Half Lid stops to protect the Mac
settings.notifications.onHoldEnding: A timed keep-awake is about to end
settings.notifications.test.title: Half Lid
settings.diagnostics.holders: What is keeping this Mac awake
settings.diagnostics.holders.none: Nothing is asking the Mac to stay awake.
settings.diagnostics.holders.note: Half Lid does not use these: it changes what closing the lid does. Other apps may hold them, and they can stop the Mac from sleeping on their own.
settings.diagnostics.screen.note: Half Lid locks the screen and sets the brightness with macOS functions that Apple does not document. If one is missing, that step is skipped, and without the lock the Mac stays unlocked behind a dark screen. In System Settings, Lock Screen, you can require the password as soon as the display turns off.
settings.diagnostics.menuBar.detail: Cannot see the icon? Check that Half Lid is allowed in the menu bar. When the bar is full, the Mac hides the icons that do not fit.
settings.diagnostics.repair.detail: Puts the lid behavior and the display brightness back to normal. Use it if something looks wrong after a crash.
settings.diagnostics.repair.busy: Half Lid is keeping the Mac awake right now. Stop that first.
settings.diagnostics.repair.done: Done. The Mac is back to normal.
settings.diagnostics.repair.failed: The repair did not fully work. Restart the Mac if something still looks wrong.
settings.diagnostics.copy.detail: A plain-text summary to paste into a bug report. It holds no file names and nothing from your chats.
settings.about.tagline: Keeps your Mac working with the lid closed while your coding agents do.
settings.about.privacy.title: Privacy
settings.about.privacy: Half Lid runs entirely on this Mac. It has no account, no analytics and makes no network connections.
settings.about.license.title: License
settings.about.license: Free and open source software, released under the MIT License.
settings.about.marks.title: Logos and trademarks
settings.about.marks: Agent logos belong to their owners and appear only to identify each agent. Half Lid is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of them.
